The '''Series III blaster pistol''' was a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] designed by [[Caelli-Merced Syndicate]].

Specifically designed for the advanced gunman, the Series III was finely crafted to the degree of exquisite excellence that Caelli-Merced was known for; a marksman's weapon, this precise [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] required a keen [[Eye/Legends|eye]] and steady hand to make use of this precisely balanced weapons full potential. Combined with its precision, the Series III packed considerable more punch than a standard blaster pistol, while remaining small and compact&ndash;making it the weapon of choice by the Caelli-Merced. Because of the high demand for the weapon, it could only be bought from [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro]] or on the [[Black market/Legends|black market]].
